text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O searches for a rival before 
the Satsuki Sho main event. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, why? Why will no one accept the role 
of my rival?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A rival is an essential part of an opera, 
is it not!? Why do you not take up the 
mantle of Count Friedrich and strike me 
down!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I don't get why they'd turn it down at 
all! Like, 'It's super embarrassing...' or 
'If my friends find out, I'll literally 
die!'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You don't get it either, right, Trainer?

I nod with all my might. Though... she 
likely wants as little to do with me as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san. Um... I'm so sorry~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How did it go, Doto? No luck on your end 
either?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I tried talking to someone who seemed 
likely to run in the Satsuki Sho, asking, 
'Won't you please become Opera O's rival?' 
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was far too intimidated by my own lack 
of skill... I couldn't bring myself to 
speak to her...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Giving up before I've even 
recruited you?! There's a limit to 
modesty, Doto!
choice_data_list: This might be pushing it a bit too far...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, Trainer-kun. There is still one 
candidate left. An Umamusume who stands a 
solid chance of making it into the Satsuki 
Sho."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, she's the only one I just can't 
catch. Why won't she show herself...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I managed to slip away. I'd 
better get it done early today too...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhh, you're...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The one person I couldn't find anywhere! 
And—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you that passionate fan who came to 
my dinner show late last year?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please don't tease me... I was really 
just passing by..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I heard. It seems your entry into the 
Satsuki Sho is practically guaranteed, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then that's perfect! How about a 
triple-promotion from fan to rival right 
now!?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one worthy of being my 
rival! My fair Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not like it's graceful or anything...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I feel an undeniable bond of fate with 
you! Which means, somehow, we must settle 
this score!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Are you really that set on dragging me 
into this? Seriously, this person...
Admire Vega was being utterly overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, for the investiture ceremony. As of 
right now, you have officially been 
appointed my rival.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I respectfully... decline. Please just 
leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Good for you, my rival. Or 
in French, mon rival.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't care either way, and I never 
agreed to take the job.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... Opera O-san. Could it be that 
Ayabe-san is uncomfortable with this?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what are you talking about, Doto? 
Are you telling me you look at things with 
your eyes open?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then close your eyes, cover your ears, 
and feel it with your heart. See? This one 
is rejoicing."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pay some attention to me, will you...?!

Their conversation isn't meshing at all... 
T.M. Opera O simply drives the discussion 
forward along her predetermined script.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, you... you know what you're doing, 
right? Say what you will, you're still 
running in the Satsuki Sho, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then you have no choice but to compete 
against me. And if that is the case, 
doesn't that make us rivals?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Or what? Are you planning to withdraw from 
the race?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's... Kuh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't... withdraw from the race. Because 
I have something... that I'm chasing after 
too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Then that means you truly 
are my rival after all!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, my dearest Admire 
Vega. Or rather—Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Even though I kept running away the 
whole time... To think I'd get caught 
right at the very end...

And so, Admire Vega was forcibly chosen to 
play the role of the rival in the Satsuki 
Sho.

Having gained a long-awaited rival, TM 
Opera O's motivation soared ever higher in 
her own self-righteous glory!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is amazing... To think she 
could invite someone so assertively...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, was that really alright? I feel 
like that might've been a bit too pushy...
